description:
Mail app that sparks joy

Features

  • Unified Inbox, kanban and chat views
  • IMAP/SMTP email and RSS/Atom feeds
  • Threaded conversations with rich-text composing and media galleries
  • Easy setup with OAuth or automatic mailbox discovery
  • Encrypted local storage with credentials kept in the OS keyring
  • Themes and 20+ languages

How it works

  • Meron syncs your mail and feeds through a shared Rust core for speed and reliability.
  • Your accounts and messages are stored encrypted on your device.
  • When you enable sender images, Meron sends a SHA-256 hash of each sender's email address to Gravatar and, as a fallback, the sender's domain to Google.
